articles.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems’ Brandon Sorbom and Helion’s David Kirtley on bringing fusion to the grid at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.description: CFS' Brandon Sorbom and Helion's David Kirtley join the Smart Systems Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to discuss the breakthroughs moving fusion forward, the challenges that remain, and what it will take to deliver fusion power to the grid at scale. Get your pass at regular price and get a second one at 50% off.
articles.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, representatives from Commonwealth Fusion Systems and Helion Energy discussed advancements in fusion technology, the existing hurdles, and the necessary steps to scale fusion power for grid use.
points: Brandon Sorbom from Commonwealth Fusion Systems and David Kirtley from Helion Energy shared insights on the progress and challenges of fusion energy.
The panelists expressed confidence in the feasibility of delivering fusion power to the grid, while acknowledging the engineering and materials science hurdles that must be overcome.
They emphasized the importance of continued research and development, as well as the need for substantial investment to make fusion energy a viable option for the grid.
articles.insight: This news suggests a growing momentum towards making fusion energy a practical option for future power grids, highlighting the industry's ongoing efforts to overcome technical and financial challenges.
